tab.label: Email
tab.title: Email
tab.intro: LibreFolio can send emails through an SMTP server, set up by whoever runs the instance. Email is optional: without it, everything else works.

off.explanation: No SMTP server is configured (LIBREFOLIO_SMTP_HOST), so nothing is sent: invitation and password-reset links are copied by hand. The guide explains how to set one up.

invalid.explanation: Email stays off until the configuration is fixed: correct the variable, then restart LibreFolio.

problems.SMTP_HOST_INVALID: {variable} is not a valid server name: write only the host name or the IP address, without scheme, port or path.
problems.SMTP_TLS_INVALID: {variable} must be starttls, tls or none.
problems.SMTP_PORT_INVALID: {variable} must be a whole number from 1 to 65535.
problems.SMTP_FROM_MISSING: {variable} is missing: the sender address is required.
problems.SMTP_FROM_INVALID: {variable} must be one address, such as noreply@example.com, optionally after a name, with the address in angle brackets.
problems.SMTP_MAX_PER_HOUR_INVALID: {variable} must be a whole number of at least 1.
problems.SMTP_PASSWORD_UNREADABLE: The password file named by {variable} cannot be read.
problems.SMTP_CREDENTIALS_INCOMPLETE: {variable} is set alone: set both the SMTP user and its password, or neither.

smtp.off: Email is off: no SMTP server is configured.
smtp.ok: The SMTP configuration can be used.
smtp.invalid: {variable} cannot be used ({problem}): email stays off until it is fixed.

smtpEncryption.ok: Emails travel encrypted, or email is off.
smtpEncryption.localPlain: Emails go unencrypted to a server of the local network.
smtpEncryption.plain: Emails, their links and the SMTP password travel unencrypted to a server outside the local network: set LIBREFOLIO_SMTP_TLS to starttls or tls.

budget.spent: The hourly limit of {max} emails is reached: the next one can go in {minutes} min.

test.hint: Send a test email to your own address to check the configuration.
test.sent: Test email sent to your address: check your inbox, and the spam folder.

errors.EMAIL_UNAVAILABLE: Email is off or not working on this instance.
errors.EMAIL_RATE_LIMITED: The hourly email limit is reached: try again in {minutes} min.
errors.EMAIL_RECIPIENT_INVALID: The address of your account is not a valid email address.
errors.generic: The test email could not be sent.

smtpErrors.CONNECTION_FAILED: LibreFolio cannot reach the SMTP server: check the host and the port.
smtpErrors.TLS_FAILED: The secure connection failed: check LIBREFOLIO_SMTP_TLS and the certificate of the server.
smtpErrors.AUTH_FAILED: The SMTP server refused the login: check the user and the password.
smtpErrors.SENDER_REFUSED: The SMTP server refused the sender address (LIBREFOLIO_SMTP_FROM).
smtpErrors.RECIPIENT_REFUSED: The SMTP server refused your address.
smtpErrors.TIMEOUT: The SMTP server did not answer in time.
smtpErrors.SEND_FAILED: The SMTP server did not take the message.

email.loadError: The state of email could not be read.
